states: Two embedded production builds on private DEMO_MODE mock stacks with fresh data dirs and telemetry off: 'before' at 732bb6856a (port 7761) and 'after' with this change (port 7762). charts.ts and its two test files are byte-identical between 732bb6856a and this commit's parent 36d3f8c557, so the after build ran the chart client content committed here; the rest of its frontend is 732bb6856a's, not 36d3f8c557's.

Proxmox overview in Trends mode: 604 guest-table sparklines over 161 rows at 1440 px and 164 over 45 rows at 390 px, identical before and after; chart reads were /api/charts/infrastructure (metrics,range) and /api/charts/workloads (maxPoints,range), all 200.
Guest drawer History tab (artifact-cache-310): Utilization, Network I/O and Disk I/O charts rendered from /api/metrics-store/history 200, identical before and after at both widths.
Storage page: 73 rows and the pool summary charts from /api/storage-charts?range 200, identical before and after at both widths.

Neither build requested /api/charts/workloads-summary or /api/charts/storage-summary on any route. Direct probes with demo credentials: both routes 200 on before, 404 on after; /api/charts/workloads, /api/charts/infrastructure and /api/storage-charts 200 on both.
No console errors or page errors and no horizontal document overflow at either width on either build.

Dist proof: vite build before/after with identical file sets after hash normalisation; only assets/useUnifiedResources-*.js (the ChartsAPI chunk) differs in code, and after normalising hashes and 1-3 character identifiers its only residual is the removed getWorkloadsSummaryCharts and getStorageSummaryTrend static methods (326 B raw, 49 B zlib). index-*.js and index.html differ only in chunk-hash and SRI integrity values.
interactions: Demo sign-in, then with workloadsMetricDisplayMode=sparklines navigate to /proxmox/overview and wait for the /api/charts/workloads read.
Click the first guest row to open its inline drawer, click the History tab, and wait for the /api/metrics-store/history read.
Navigate to /proxmox/storage and wait for the /api/storage-charts read.

Record every /api/charts*, /api/storage-charts and /api/metrics-store request with its status; same script in a 1440x900 desktop context and a 390x844 phone context against both builds; screenshots of overview, drawer and storage inspected.
